verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents unlimited custom fields. Its built-in Copilot can configure fields from plain-English requests within the user's existing permissions, which supports the 'no admin project' part of the story. There is no evidence of saved views that a user can filter, sort and share; the 'filtered list' for campaigns and external data sharing are adjacent features, not view-building. Missing for 10: documented filtered/sorted saved views, view sharing among teammates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Define your own pipeline stages and add unlimited custom fields
Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.
